text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All things in the universe can be divided 
into Yin and Yang. For example, Yin is 
water, the moon, earth, while Yang is 
fire, the sun, heaven... and so on!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
They might feel like conflicting elements, 
but we mustn't forget... it's only when 
the two blend together that true balance 
is born.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's the same with mindsets. Too much yang 
energy makes you reckless, while too much 
yin energy makes you neurotic.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In other words... in all things, the 
'golden mean'â we should aim for 
balance, right!
